scientific_limitations: The sunlet polynomial assumes one distinct pendant leaf at each vertex of a simple cycle of length at least three. The structural classification holds for arbitrary finite simple base graphs, but does not provide a polynomial-time optimizer for arbitrary bases. Historical priority is subject to unindexed equivalences; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
